properties.description: 공통 자식: 마스터 첫 단계. ctl_master_pipeline_run PENDING 등록 + 시작 조건 검증 (v8.3). 실패 시 마스터도 실패.

activities.name: Ins_master_run
activities.description: PENDING 등록 (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) + 검증 4종 (RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_JOB_TYPE / TARGET_NOT_IN_GROUP / INCR_COND_VAR_INVALID / INCR_POLICY_MISMATCH)

text.value:
/* pl_cmn_master_start > Script "Ins_master_run" (v8.3)
   마스터 첫 활동. ctl_master_pipeline_run PENDING 등록 + 시작 조건 검증 (child_total_cnt = 0)
   검증 실패 : 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (문장 전체 취소, Master 행 생성 안 됨)
   같은 master_run_id 재호출 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) : 자동 Retry / Rerun from failed activity 대비
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'), '')                 AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_pipeline_nm}'), '')            AS pipeline_nm,
           trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_type}')                             AS trigger_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'), ''), 'Manual') AS trigger_nm,
           string_to_array(upper(replace('@{pipeline().parameters.p_job_types}', ' ', '')), ',') AS job_types,
           trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}')                             AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'), '')::timestamptz  AS scheduled_dt,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'), '')::jsonb            AS target_ids,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val}'), '')                AS incr_from_val,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_bizday_n}'), '')                     AS bizday_n,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_bizday_offset}'), '')                AS bizday_offset,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_dbx_last_run_yn}'), '')              AS dbx_last_run_yn,
           NULLIF(upper(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_cond_unit}')), '')             AS cond_unit,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_cond_interval}'), '')                AS cond_interval,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_entry_run_id}'), '')                 AS entry_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                          AS created_by
),
/* 그룹 : 활성 + 이 마스터가 받는 작업유형 */
g AS (
    SELECT p.*, g.run_group_id, g.job_type_cd
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd = ANY (p.job_types)
),
/* 수동 지정 target_id 목록 */
req AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT x::bigint AS target_id
      FROM p, jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p.target_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) x
),
/* 이번 실행 수집 대상 (검증용, 건수는 기록하지 않음) */
tgt AS (
    SELECT e.target_id, e.range_unit_cd, e.range_interval
      FROM g
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e ON e.run_group_id = g.run_group_id
     WHERE g.target_ids IS NULL
        OR e.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM req)
),
/* 검증 1 : 지정했지만 그룹 대상이 아닌 target_id */
nf AS (
    SELECT string_agg(r.target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY r.target_id) AS ids
      FROM req r
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tgt t WHERE t.target_id = r.target_id)
),
/* 검증 2 : INCR 그룹 대상 중 증분정책(단위, N)이 마스터 설정과 다른 대상 */
mm AS (
    SELECT string_agg(t.target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY t.target_id) AS ids
      FROM tgt t, g
     WHERE g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR'
       AND (   t.range_unit_cd IS DISTINCT FROM g.cond_unit
            OR t.range_interval::text IS DISTINCT FROM g.cond_interval)
),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, scheduled_dt, run_group_id,
           run_param, entry_run_id, child_total_cnt, status, created_by)
    SELECT g.master_run_id, g.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN g.trigger_type = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE 'SCHEDULE' END,
           g.trigger_nm,
           g.scheduled_dt,
           g.run_group_id,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
               'target_ids',      g.target_ids,
               'incr_from_val',   g.incr_from_val,
               'bizday_n',        g.bizday_n,
               'bizday_offset',   g.bizday_offset,
               'dbx_last_run_yn', g.dbx_last_run_yn,
               'condition',       CASE WHEN g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR' THEN g.cond_unit || '/' || g.cond_interval END)),
           g.entry_run_id,
           0,
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by
      FROM g
     WHERE g.master_run_id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.pipeline_nm IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, run_group_id, run_param, child_total_cnt, status
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.adf_trigger_nm, i.run_group_id,
       i.run_param::text AS run_param, i.child_total_cnt, i.status,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT master_run_id IS NULL OR pipeline_nm IS NULL FROM p)
            THEN ('MASTER_PARAM_MISSING:' || (SELECT COALESCE(master_run_id, '') || '/' || COALESCE(pipeline_nm, '') FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g) = 0
            THEN ('RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_JOB_TYPE:' || (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT ids FROM nf) IS NOT NULL
            THEN ('TARGET_NOT_IN_GROUP:' || (SELECT ids FROM nf))::int
            WHEN (SELECT job_type_cd FROM g) = 'RAW_INCR'
             AND (SELECT cond_unit IS NULL OR cond_unit NOT IN ('DAY','MONTH','HOUR','MINUTE')
                         OR cond_interval IS NULL OR cond_interval !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' FROM p)
            THEN ('INCR_COND_VAR_INVALID:' || (SELECT COALESCE(cond_unit, '') || '/' || COALESCE(cond_interval, '') FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT ids FROM mm) IS NOT NULL
            THEN ('INCR_POLICY_MISMATCH:' || (SELECT cond_unit || '/' || cond_interval FROM p)
                  || ':' || (SELECT ids FROM mm))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_master_pipeline_run
(
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    trigger_id,
    trigger_nm,
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    init_yn,
    start_dt,
    end_dt,
    exec_group,
    child_total_cnt,
    child_succ_cnt,
    child_fail_cnt,
    status,
    run_mode,
    created_by,
    created_dt
)
VALUES
(
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_pipeline_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_data_class}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_type}',
    'N',
    NOW(),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    (select count(1)
FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m
    WHERE m.data_class = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_data_class}'
     AND m.ingest_type = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_type}'
     AND m.init_wait_yn = 'N'
     AND m.delete_yn = 'N'),
    0,
    0,
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_status}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_runmode}',
    'ADF',
    NOW()
);

UPDATE "ADFADM".ctl_master_pipeline_run m
SET
    child_total_cnt = s.child_total_cnt,
    child_succ_cnt  = s.child_succ_cnt,
    child_fail_cnt  = s.child_fail_cnt,
    end_dt          = NOW(),
    status           = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_status}',
    update_by        = 'ADF',
    update_dt        = NOW()
FROM
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int4 AS child_total_cnt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        )::int4 AS child_succ_cnt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'FAILED'
        )::int4 AS child_fail_cnt
    FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
) s
WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}';

INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_master_pipeline_run
(
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    trigger_id,
    trigger_nm,
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    init_yn,
    start_dt,
    end_dt,
    exec_group,
    child_total_cnt,
    child_succ_cnt,
    child_fail_cnt,
    status,
    run_mode,
    created_by,
    created_dt
)
VALUES
(
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_pipeline_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_data_class}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_type}',
    'Y',
    NOW(),
    NULL,
    NULL,

    (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(m.partition_clause), '') IS NULL
                            THEN 1

                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(
                                 NULLIF(m.partition_clause, '')::jsonb
                                 -> 'partition_val'
                             ) = 'array'
                            THEN jsonb_array_length(
                                     NULLIF(m.partition_clause, '')::jsonb
                                     -> 'partition_val'
                                 )

                        ELSE 1
                    END
                ),
                0
            )::int4

        FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m

        WHERE  m.init_wait_yn =
              'Y'

          AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
    ),

    0,
    0,
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_status}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_runmode}',
    'ADF',
    NOW()
);

INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_trigger_history
(
    trigger_id,
    trigger_nm,
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    skip_yn,
    skip_reason,
    created_by,
    created_dt,
    update_by,
    update_dt
)
VALUES
(
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_pipeline_nm}',
    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_skip_yn}',

    NULLIF(
        '@{replace(
            pipeline().parameters.p_skip_reason,
            '''',
            ''''''
        )}',
        ''
    ),

    'ADF',
    NOW(),
    NULL,
    NULL
);
